rows.name: Steakhouse Financial
farm_steps: Create a fresh wallet for Steakhouse Financial (steakhouse-financial), keep the seed offline and fund it with about $174 on Base: the position plus gas.
Deposit $150 of USDC into the largest vault on Steakhouse Financial (Base) and confirm the share token appears in your wallet.
Add to or rebalance the Steakhouse Financial position once a week for 30 days so the activity is counted in more than one snapshot.

If Steakhouse Financial offers a second, higher-risk vault, move no more than $75 there and only after the first has run for two weeks.
Log each Steakhouse Financial transaction with its date and hash in a sheet, so you can repeat the position or unwind it if the rules change.
